text:
sam: AM async: did a kernel prefetch refactor (moved a lock-free path), ran microbatch perf bench against staging. ~6% p95 improvement on 1k seq. Blocker: intermittent flake in slot_allocator::assign_slots (map resize race, ~1/200 builds). Today: triage race, open patch, rerun bench with KV warmup enabled.

rachel: saw this yesterday too. suspect the rehash during concurrent assign. quick hack was holding global map lock in tests but that kills perf. I'll open a PR w/ RWMutex suggestion.

kevin: pushed a canary to staging with the new bench harness + KV warmup on. Cold-start p95 spikes ~450ms then drops to ~120ms after warmup. logs -> http://ci/builds/7823

jen: can you paste the bench summary (numbers)?

sam: sure — bench stdout snippet:
```
microbatch throughput: 240 req/s
p50: 28ms, p95: 128ms -> after patch p95: 120ms
cold-start p95: 456ms (first 50 iters)
```
sam: also seeing KV cache miss rate ~18% on first minute, then ~2% after warmup.

alex: I can run tracing for KV warmup (heap + evict stats) — kicking off a job now, will tag results. add runbook note: `/ops add-kv-trace`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded for build 7823 :white_check_mark:

rachel: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/438 — adds RWMutex and a regression test that reproduces the resize.

kevin: thanks. sam, once test fix lands can you re-run the bench with the canary? if it still flakes we'll instrument slot_allocator deeper.

sam: will do — plan to land the test fix today and re-run the evening bench. ping me if you need the job id.

jen: all good from product side, no blocker. keep us posted :thumbsup:

alex: trace job started -> trace id kv-warm-20260318-7

sam: ack; added to today's TODOs and the bench run queue.
